invariants.statement: Every declared member GET or POST route is authorized on the server; an anonymous request receives a 303 login redirect with a validated same-origin next path before protected content or mutation executes.
acceptance_obligations: Direct URL, refresh, expired or revoked session, logout revisit and anonymous mutations fail closed.

invariants.statement: Return paths accept only local absolute paths and reject schemes, network paths, backslashes, repeated encoded backslashes, NUL and other open-redirect forms.
acceptance_obligations: Malformed next values resolve to the fixed member landing route.

invariants.statement: Verification challenges are salted hashes at rest; normal HTTP pages and APIs never expose plaintext codes, and the explicit test seam is in-process, session-bound and purpose-bound.
acceptance_obligations: The retired outbox endpoint returns 404 and database/log scans contain no plaintext challenge.

invariants.statement: Favorite, library, progress, subscription, order, preference and settings mutations derive owner from the server-side authenticated session and fail closed across actors.
acceptance_obligations: Actor A state cannot be read, changed or deleted by actor B.

invariants.statement: The SQLite database is bound to site id blinkist; initialization, restart, migration, backup and restore reject a foreign-site binding.
acceptance_obligations: Fresh and replayed initialization succeed for blinkist while a foreign binding fails closed.

invariants.statement: Candidate documents, scripts, styles, images, fetches, WebSockets, beacons, frames and external effects remain loopback or data-only with zero public runtime requests.
acceptance_obligations: Browser network audit and static diagnostic record zero remote runtime references.

invariants.statement: Mail and payment effects are local-only: no real message, card detail, provider call, live key, source entitlement or source mutation is accepted or emitted.
acceptance_obligations: Normal mail access is unavailable over HTTP and runtime stripe_test remains null.

invariants.statement: Premium amount, USD currency, owner, product and fingerprint are server-derived; approved, declined and retryable scenarios are allowlisted local outcomes and approval consumption is owner-bound.
acceptance_obligations: Forged amount, stale fingerprint, foreign owner and invalid scenario fail closed.

invariants.statement: Duplicate registration, favorite and payment attempts preserve uniqueness and do not create duplicate durable effects.
acceptance_obligations: Concurrent duplicate requests leave a normalized single logical result.

invariants.statement: Accounts, favorites, subscriptions and revocations persist across process restart in the isolated site database.
acceptance_obligations: A revoked session remains revoked after restart.
